title: If I didn't know these were Corelle, I would have never guessed it.
text:
If I didn't know these were Corelle, I would have never guessed it.. I love Corelle. I own odd plates from my mom, and two of my own sets. So I thought these would be good to try.

I have to say that these are different from any of my other Corelle ware.
The color is nice, and the quality is still there. But they feel different.

These are VERY heavy when compared to my other Corelle plates. I really don't know why, or if this is a different lines, or what the deal might be. To me, they are awkwardly heavy. I thought maybe they did a stoneware line, because that's what they feel like. But the box says they are still glass.

I don't plan on adding them to our daily use dishes. Too heavy for comfortable handling.
